diagnosis.previous_behavior: SegFormer jobs declared sample_size=768 and context_bounds=128, but pseudolabel inference inserted the full 1024x1024 tile prediction into the scene probability map.
diagnosis.artifact_cause: Uncropped tile borders from SegFormer predictions were included in stitching. Those border predictions can appear as rectangular tile artifacts after thresholding/vectorization.
diagnosis.fix: SegFormer pseudolabel inference now uses center crop insertion by default when sample_size/context_bounds are configured. Interior 1024 tiles insert only the central 768 pixels with +128 offset; edge tiles keep the outer edge area to avoid coverage gaps.

warnings: Debug was run on one scene only to avoid heavy training/inference.
Existing running DeepLab job was not interrupted; code was deployed without service restart.
